reserve_profile.summary: Paxos terms state that USDG issued by Paxos Digital Singapore or Paxos Issuance Europe is backed one-to-one by U.S.-dollar deposits or permitted U.S.-dollar-denominated debt instruments held in segregated accounts for token holders.

redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Fully verified Paxos customers served by Paxos Digital Singapore or Paxos Issuance Europe where the applicable entity and jurisdiction permit USDG issuance or redemption.
redemption_profile.minimum_amount_text: Paxos may require a redemption minimum equal to the applicable bank wire fee; the minimum may change and redemptions are rounded down to the nearest U.S. cent.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Paxos states that it does not charge a USD Stablecoin redemption fee, while banking, wallet, transfer, account, or other third-party fees may apply.
redemption_profile.settlement_time_text: Paxos states that U.S.-dollar withdrawals may take up to two days, with larger withdrawals potentially taking substantially longer; compliance review may also delay processing.
jurisdiction_restrictions: Only verified Paxos customers may redeem directly.
Service availability depends on residence and the Paxos entity with which the customer is registered.
Paxos may refuse or suspend issuance or redemption for compliance, account, legal, or platform reasons.
